notes_title: v13: beak drawn from your side close-up
notes: v13 rebuilds the beak from your close-up photo. (1) The top of the beak slopes gently and evenly from high on the forehead down to a blunt, slightly hooked tip. (2) The white wraps back over the cheeks like the costume's fabric panel. (3) The mouth line runs back along the cheek to a corner right under the eye, where the top and bottom join, with red inside. (4) The lower beak is longer and runs under the upper one, ending a little behind its tip. Check from the side against your photo. Also look from the front: the red of the mouth now shows less from straight on than in v12.
